verdict.rationale: Convex lists "Crons" as a feature on its Free & Starter plans, and its llms.txt says it includes a scheduler for running background workflows. That is first-party evidence of recurring scheduling, but it appears only as a pricing-list bullet and a one-line summary. Missing for 10: documentation of how cron jobs are defined and configured (intervals, cron syntax), detail on recurring workflow orchestration beyond a one-off scheduler mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
